summary: Declares the ARROW: a host's layers and the direction a dependency between them may run, enforced generically (the ArchUnit layered-rule / import-linter contract form). The host declares the layers, the rules and how a dependency is read in each kind of file; the kit ships only the grammar and one interpreter, applied over the tree by `check` and over the text an edit introduces by the enforcement line's ONE judge -- no second judge. Every reading and every rule is calibrated before it is believed. The gate ships at the declared default stance like every other gate; a host that must loosen it signs a stance row.
